headline: British Pound Strengthens as Equity Market Rebound Reduces US Dollar Demand
summary: Sterling firmed against the US dollar on Monday as a stabilization in global equity markets reduced safe-haven demand for greenbacks.
why: The British Pound is a major reserve currency whose exchange rate reflects global risk appetite and UK macroeconomic stability.

impacts.name: GBP/USD
impacts.why: The British pound appreciated against the US dollar as risk appetite stabilized.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A rebound in global stock markets trimmed safe-haven bids for the US dollar, lifting sterling.
